text:
zara: Heads-up — I'm drafting the release notes for next week's docs push. Main items: migration guide for v0.9 -> v1.0, updated SDK snippets for the new streaming API, and a Known Issues section for embed streaming fallback. Need quick checks before Friday.

jay: I'll skim the SDK snippets. Saw one failing in the python gallery last night. Which PR should I reference?

zara: @jay it's PR #4248 (docs/snippets/streaming-update). I left a TODO where the python example uses old client.call().

miguel: Re: migration guide — I noticed the curl examples still show the old /v1/generate endpoint. I can update them but will need to run the smoke build to confirm anchors.

elaine: I can run the local build and anchorcheck. Command I use:
```
make site && scripts/anchor-check --report=broken-links.md
```
I'll post the report here.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs CI job docs-linkcheck triggered on PR #4248. Status: failed (2 broken anchors).

sam: The broken anchors were on the rollout section — the H2 ids changed when we renamed "deployment" to "private-deploy". I can add redirects in the frontmatter to preserve existing links.

jay: Quick note on snippets: python and js examples diverge in how they call streaming. For py we use `client.generate_stream`, js uses `client.stream.generate`. I'd prefer we standardize on `generate_stream` in docs and provide a one-liner compatibility note for older SDK versions.

zara: Good call. @jay can you propose the standardized snippets and I'll slot them into the relnotes? Also need a concise Known Issue blurb about the embed streaming fallback that mentions: "If streaming falls back to polling, tokens may be delayed up to 2s; automatic retry will resume streaming when capacity restores."

miguel: I'll update the migration guide curl endpoints and add an example cURL + jq snippet for the new response shape.

elaine: anchor-check report attached (pasted):
- docs/guides/migration.md: missing anchor #private-deploy (2 refs)
- docs/snippets/streaming.md: example id mismatch

zara: Thanks — @sam can you add the frontmatter redirects for migration.md and I'll re-run CI after the snippet PR is updated.

sam: On it, will push a tiny redirect patch (docs: add redirect for migration private-deploy) in a few mins.

jay: Drafted standardized snippets, pushed to PR #4252 (branch: docs/stream-snippet-unify). Left comments in the python snippet about older client versions.

docs-bot: CI update: PR #4252 lint OK, snippet-tests failed (1 failing test). See logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.test/4252/logs

zara: Can someone take the snippet-test failure? If it's just a whitespace/format issue I'll handle it, but if the test indicates runtime change we need to adjust wording in relnotes.

miguel: I'll take a look now. If runtime, I'll add a short callout in Known Issues: "SDK snippet tests may fail on SDK <0.9.1 due to API rename; use compatibility section."

zara: Perfect. Plan: finish edits by Thursday EOD, final review Friday morning, publish Friday afternoon. Please ping here when you've pushed fixes. :tada:
